```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE,message = FALSE,warning = FALSE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev = "png", dpi = 300, echo = FALSE)

library(immunarch)
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(cowplot)
```

```{r load_data}
files_mixcr <- list.files("./1_Ig_all_unfiltered_contigs/", full.names = T)
sample_all <- map(.x = files_mixcr, function (x) read_tsv(x))
names(sample_all) <- str_split(list.files("./1_Ig_all_unfiltered_contigs/"),"\\.", simplify = T)[,1]
count_mixcr_out <- tibble(Sample = names(sample_all), 
                          Count = map(sample_all, function(x) nrow(x)) %>% unlist,
                          Type = "MiXCR_out")
```

# Check if all contigs have CDR3 and defined isotype (no missing aaseqCDR3, bestVGene, bestJGene, or bestCGene)

```{r Contigs_with_CDR3_isotype, fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
sample_all <- map(sample_all, function (x)
  filter(.data = x, !is.na(aaSeqCDR3) & !is.na(bestVGene) & !is.na(bestJGene) & !is.na(bestCGene)))

count_sample_all <- tibble(Sample = names(sample_all), 
                           Count = map(sample_all, function(x) nrow(x)) %>% unlist,
                           Type = "Defined_isotype")
```

# Add information about Infection types by Hashtag oligos (HTO) table from CellRanger FB output, demultiplexed by HTODemux in Seurat (method 1) (BETTER)
```{r hto_load}
files_hto <- list.files("./cell_hashtag2/", full.names = T)
hto_all <-  map(.x = files_hto, function (x) read_csv(x))
names(hto_all) <- str_split(list.files("./cell_hashtag2/"),"\\.", simplify = T)[,1]
```

```{r hto_format, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
hto_all <- map(hto_all, function(x) x %>% summarise(barcode = str_split(barcode,"-", simplify = T)[,1],
                                                   cell_cluster = str_split(Hashtag, "-", simplify = T)[,1],
                                                   infection = paste(str_split(Hashtag, "-", simplify = T)[,2],
                                                                    str_split(Hashtag, "-", simplify = T)[,3],
                                                                    sep = ";")))

# Save the reformatted files
map2(hto_all, names(hto_all), function(x,y) write_csv(x, paste0("./",y,".csv")))

map(hto_all, function(x) table(x$cell_cluster))
map(hto_all, function(x) table(x$infection))
```
 
```{r hto_merge}
# Merge the HTO table to the mixcr table by cell barcode
sample_all_hto <- map2(sample_all, hto_all, function(x,y)
  inner_join(x, y, by = c("tagValueCELL" = "barcode")))

map(sample_all_hto, function(x) table(x$cell_cluster))
map(sample_all_hto, function(x) table(x$infection))

count_hto_all <- tibble(Sample = names(sample_all_hto), 
                           Count = map(sample_all_hto, function(x) nrow(x)) %>% unlist,
                           Type = "Demultiplex_cell_hashtag")
```

# Filter for singlet droplets (1 cell barcode appear only twice) or multiplets but must have different hashtag barcode (4 hashtags by infection type)

```{r contigs_singlets, fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
# For each replicate, group by cell barcode, the chain, and the hashtag (4 infection types and 2 tissue types for rep1, only 4 infection types for rep2 and rep3) so that there should be only one unique combination of all 3 features (count the occurrence of the combinations and filter for combinations that appear only once)
barcode_hashtag_filter <- map(sample_all_hto, function (x) x %>% group_by(tagValueCELL, chains, infection) %>% summarize(n = n()) %>% filter(n == 1))

# List out cell barcodes that appear twice in one infection
barcode_two <- map(barcode_hashtag_filter, function(x) x %>% group_by(tagValueCELL, infection) %>% filter(n() == 2) %>% pull(tagValueCELL))

# Select for contigs that have barcode_two
sample_all_paired <- map2(.x = sample_all_hto, .y = barcode_two, function (x,y) x[which(x$tagValueCELL %in% y),])

count_sample_all_paired <- tibble(Sample = names(sample_all_paired), 
                           Count = map(sample_all_paired, function(x) nrow(x)) %>% unlist,
                           Type = "Singlets")
```

# Check if the barcode pairing is between one heavy and one light chain and filter

```{r contigs_paired_correct, fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
# Group the df by cell barcode and paste the chain name together
sample_all_paired_2 <- map(sample_all_paired, function(x) 
                           x %>% group_by(tagValueCELL) %>% 
                           mutate(chainsPair = paste(chains, collapse = ";")))

# Filter the df by allowing only heavy and light chain pairing
sample_all_paired_2 <- map(sample_all_paired_2, function(x)
                           filter(x, chainsPair == "IGH;IGK"| chainsPair == "IGH;IGL"|
                                  chainsPair == "IGK;IGH"| chainsPair == "IGL;IGH"))
# Double check the pairing
lapply(sample_all_paired_2, function(x) table(x$chainsPair))

count_sample_all_paired_2 <- tibble(Sample = names(sample_all_paired_2), 
                           Count = map(sample_all_paired_2, function(x) nrow(x)) %>% unlist,
                           Type = "Correct_pairing")

map(sample_all_paired_2, function(x) table(x$cell_cluster))
map(sample_all_paired_2, function(x) table(x$infection))
```

# Add Ag-specifity information by dCODE hashtag (either CA07, or PR8, or Cross (CA07+PR8)) (No OVA specificity)
```{r HA_binding}
files_dCODE <- list.files("./HA_binding_hashtag2/", full.names = T)
dCODE_all <-  map(.x = files_dCODE, function (x) read_csv(x))
names(dCODE_all) <- str_split(list.files("./HA_binding_hashtag2/"),"_", simplify = T)[,1]

for (i in 1:length(dCODE_all)){
  dCODE_all[[i]]$barcode <- str_remove_all(dCODE_all[[i]]$barcode, "-1")
}

# remove all non-Ag specific barcode from the df
dCODE_all <- map(dCODE_all, function(x) x %>% filter(!HA_binding == "Negative"))
```

```{r HA_binding_merge}
# Merge the dCODE table to the mixcr table by cell barcode
sample_all_dCODE <- map2(sample_all_paired_2, dCODE_all, function(x,y)
  inner_join(x, y, by = c("tagValueCELL" = "barcode")))

map(sample_all_dCODE, function(x) table(x$HA_binding))

count_dCODE_all <- tibble(Sample = names(sample_all_dCODE), 
                           Count = map(sample_all_dCODE, function(x) nrow(x)) %>% unlist,
                           Type = "Demultiplex_Ag_binding")
```

# Save the contig outputs
```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Save the filtered contigs
map2(.x = sample_all_dCODE, .y = names(sample_all_dCODE), function (x,y) write_tsv(x, file = paste0("./2_Ig_all_filtered_contigs/",y,".txt")))
```

# Track how much contigs are lost after all pre-processing steps
```{r contigs_track, fig.height=8, fig.width=16}
count_processing <- rbind(count_mixcr_out, count_sample_all, count_hto_all,
                          count_dCODE_all, count_sample_all_paired, count_sample_all_paired_2)
count_processing <- count_processing %>% group_by(Sample) %>% mutate(Proportion = round(Count/max(Count),2))

ggplot(count_processing, aes(x = factor(Type, levels = c("MiXCR_out", "Defined_isotype","Demultiplex_cell_hashtag", "Singlets", "Correct_pairing","Demultiplex_Ag_binding")), y = Count, group = Sample, color = Sample)) +
  geom_step() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count), hjust = 1.2, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  scale_color_brewer(type = "qual", palette = "Set1") +
  theme_half_open() +
  theme(legend.position = "right", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0)) +
  labs(title = "Contigs remaining after processing", x = "Processing step")
```
\newpage
```{r contigs_track_prop, fig.height=8, fig.width=16}
ggplot(count_processing, aes(x = factor(Type, levels = c("MiXCR_out", "Defined_isotype","Demultiplex_cell_hashtag", "Singlets", "Correct_pairing", "Demultiplex_Ag_binding")), y = Proportion, group = Sample, color = Sample)) +
  geom_step() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Proportion), hjust = 1.2, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  scale_color_brewer(type = "qual", palette = "Set1") +
  theme_half_open() +
  theme(legend.position = "right", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0)) +
  labs(title = "Contigs proportion remaining after processing", x = "Processing step")

```

Overall, we lose the majority of contigs after several steps of pre-processing the data. Until the last step, we retained from 25% data in the best case (rep1) to only 6% in the worst case (rep3). The biggest loss of data ocurred during the filtering for singlets, as expected, with loss around 66% of contigs or more. The hashtagging did not seem to help much, as the proportion of lost contigs is similar to what we had before (10X VDJ-seq without hashtagging).

# Collapse the contigs into clonotypes

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Split the samples into heavy and light chain
# Check how many cells barcode a clonotype has (by cloneID)
lapply(sample_all_dCODE, function(x) table(table(x$cloneId)))

# Collapse contigs into clonotypes by: group the rows by cloneID and hashtag barcode (infection type), paste the cell barcodes together with ";", sum up the readCount and unique UMI count columns, create a new cellCount column by counting the number of rows in each group, the remaining columns SHOULD be identical, and just take the unique value of that.

sample_all_clonotypes <- map(sample_all_dCODE, function (x)
  x %>% group_by(cloneId, infection)  %>% 
  summarise(tagValueCELL = paste(tagValueCELL, collapse = ";"),
            readCount = sum(readCount), uniqueUMICount = sum(uniqueUMICount),
            cellCount = length(cloneId), targetSequences = unique(targetSequences),
            targetQualities = unique(targetQualities),
            allVHitsWithScore = unique(allVHitsWithScore),
            allDHitsWithScore = unique(allDHitsWithScore),
            allJHitsWithScore = unique(allJHitsWithScore),
            allCHitsWithScore = unique(allCHitsWithScore),
            allVAlignments = unique(allVAlignments),
            allDAlignments = unique(allDAlignments),
            allJAlignments = unique(allJAlignments),
            allCAlignments = unique(allCAlignments),
            nSeqFR1 = unique(nSeqFR1), minQualFR1 = unique(minQualFR1),
            nSeqCDR1 = unique(nSeqCDR1), minQualCDR1 = unique(minQualCDR1),
            nSeqFR2 = unique(nSeqFR2), minQualFR2 = unique(minQualFR2),
            nSeqCDR2 = unique(nSeqCDR2), minQualCDR2 = unique(minQualCDR2),
            nSeqFR3 = unique(nSeqFR3), minQualFR3 = unique(minQualFR3),
            nSeqCDR3 = unique(nSeqCDR3), minQualCDR3 = unique(minQualCDR3),
            nSeqFR4 = unique(nSeqFR4), minQualFR4 = unique(minQualFR4),
            aaSeqFR1 = unique(aaSeqFR1), aaSeqCDR1 = unique(aaSeqCDR1),
            aaSeqFR2 = unique(aaSeqFR2), aaSeqCDR2 = unique(aaSeqCDR2),
            aaSeqFR3 = unique(aaSeqFR3), aaSeqCDR3 = unique(aaSeqCDR3),
            aaSeqFR4 = unique(aaSeqFR4), refPoints = unique(refPoints),
            bestVGene = unique(bestVGene), bestDGene = unique(bestDGene),
            bestJGene = unique(bestJGene), bestCGene = unique(bestCGene),
            chains = unique(chains), nSeqVDJRegion = unique(nSeqVDJRegion),
            aaSeqVDJRegion = unique(aaSeqVDJRegion),
            aaSeqImputedVDJRegion = unique(aaSeqImputedVDJRegion),
            #tissue_type = paste(unique(na.omit(tissue_type)), collapse = ";"),
            infection = paste(unique(na.omit(infection)), collapse = "-"),
            #cluster_id = paste(unique(na.omit(cluster_id)), collapse = ";"),
            cell_cluster = paste(unique(na.omit(cell_cluster)), collapse = ";"),
            HA_binding = paste(unique(na.omit(HA_binding)), collapse = ";")
            ))
names(sample_all_clonotypes) <- str_replace_all(names(sample_all_clonotypes), "contigs", "clonotypes")


map(sample_all_clonotypes, function(x) table(x$cell_cluster))
map(sample_all_clonotypes, function(x) table(x$infection))
map(sample_all_clonotypes, function(x) table(x$HA_binding))

# Consolidate the clonotypes HA binding rules as follows: (OLD, DO NOT USE)
# 1) Cross and something else is specific to both CA07 and PR8  
# 2) OVA and CA07 or PR8, remove the OVA.
# 3) CA07 and PR8 separately becomes CA07+PR8.
# 4) CA07 and nothing else (or with OVA) is CA07-specific.
# 5) PR8 and nothing else (or with OVA) is PR8-specific.
# 6) OVA and nothing else is OVA-specific.
# 7) Blank cells are cells with no HA_binding information

#Consolidate the clonotypes HA binding rules as follows:
#1) Cross(CA07+PR8) and something else is specific to both CA07 and PR8  
#2) CA07 and PR8 separately becomes CA07+PR8.
#4) CA07 and nothing else is CA07-specific.
#5) PR8 and nothing elseis PR8-specific.

for(i in 1:length(sample_all_clonotypes)){
  sample_all_clonotypes[[i]]$HA_binding[str_which(sample_all_clonotypes[[i]]$HA_binding, "Cross")] <- "Cross"
  sample_all_clonotypes[[i]]$HA_binding[str_which(sample_all_clonotypes[[i]]$HA_binding, "CA07;PR8|PR8;CA07")] <- "Cross"
}

map(sample_all_clonotypes, function(x) table(x$HA_binding))

# Fix for rep1 cell clusters
sample_all_clonotypes[[1]]$cell_cluster[str_which(sample_all_clonotypes[[1]]$cell_cluster, "MBC;GC")] <- "GC;MBC"

# Save the full clonotypes
map2(.x = sample_all_clonotypes, .y = names(sample_all_clonotypes), function (x,y) write_tsv(x, file = paste0("./3_Ig_all_filtered_clonotypes/",y,".txt")))

# Split each sample into heavy and light chain
sample_all_clonotypes_heavy <- map(sample_all_clonotypes, function(x)
  x %>% filter(chains == "IGH"))
sample_all_clonotypes_light <- map(sample_all_clonotypes, function(x)
  x %>% filter(chains != "IGH"))

map(sample_all_clonotypes_heavy, function(x) table(x$infection))
map(sample_all_clonotypes_light, function(x) table(x$infection))

# Save the split clonotypes
map2(.x = sample_all_clonotypes_heavy, .y = names(sample_all_clonotypes_heavy), function (x,y) write_tsv(x, file = paste0("./4_Ig_all_clonotypes_split/",y,"_hc.txt")))
map2(.x = sample_all_clonotypes_light, .y = names(sample_all_clonotypes_light), function (x,y) write_tsv(x, file = paste0("./4_Ig_all_clonotypes_split/",y,"_lc.txt")))
```

Consolidate the clonotypes HA binding rules as follows:
1) Cross(CA07+PR8) and something else is specific to both CA07 and PR8  
2) CA07 and PR8 separately becomes CA07+PR8.
4) CA07 and nothing else is CA07-specific.
5) PR8 and nothing elseis PR8-specific.


# Split each sample into sub-samples infection type (i.e hashtag barcode)
```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
#Load the data in immunarch
data_all <- repLoad("./4_Ig_all_clonotypes_split/", .coding = FALSE)

# Load the data from the source mixcr files
path <- list.files("./4_Ig_all_clonotypes_split/", full.names = T)
mixcr_all <- lapply(path, function (x) read_tsv(x))

names(mixcr_all) <- str_split(list.files("./4_Ig_all_clonotypes_split/"), "\\.", simplify = T)[,1]
names(mixcr_all) <- str_remove_all(names(data_all$data),"rep") %>% str_remove_all(.,"_clonotypes")
names(data_all$data) <- names(mixcr_all)

# Sort the immunarch data by the order of mixcr cloneID
data_all$data <- map(data_all$data, function(x) arrange(x, Clone.ID))

# Replace the clonal count in immunarch with the unique UMI count in mixcr, gene name without score, and imputed VDJ seq (for future cloning)
for (i in 1:length(data_all$data)){
  data_all$data[[i]]$Clones <- mixcr_all[[i]]$cellCount
  data_all$data[[i]]$Proportion <- data_all$data[[i]]$Clones/sum(data_all$data[[i]]$Clones)
  data_all$data[[i]]$V.name <- mixcr_all[[i]]$bestVGene
  data_all$data[[i]]$D.name <- mixcr_all[[i]]$bestDGene
  data_all$data[[i]]$J.name <- mixcr_all[[i]]$bestJGene
  data_all$data[[i]]$C.name <- mixcr_all[[i]]$bestCGene
  data_all$data[[i]]$Sequence.aa <- mixcr_all[[i]]$aaSeqVDJRegion
  data_all$data[[i]]$Sequence.aa.imputed <- mixcr_all[[i]]$aaSeqImputedVDJRegion
  data_all$data[[i]]$UMI.count <- mixcr_all[[i]]$uniqueUMICount
  data_all$data[[i]]$Barcode <- mixcr_all[[i]]$tagValueCELL
  data_all$data[[i]]$Tissue.type <- mixcr_all[[i]]$tissue_type
  data_all$data[[i]]$Infections <- mixcr_all[[i]]$infection
  #data_all$data[[i]]$Cluster.Id <- mixcr_all[[i]]$cluster_id
  data_all$data[[i]]$Cell.cluster <- mixcr_all[[i]]$cell_cluster
  data_all$data[[i]]$HA.binding <- mixcr_all[[i]]$HA_binding
}

# Split the dataset by hashtag barcode (infection condition)
map(data_all$data, function(x) table(x$Infections))

filter_1 <- map(data_all$data, function(x) x %>% filter(Infections == "CA07;CA07"))
filter_2 <- map(data_all$data, function(x) x %>% filter(Infections == "PBS;CA07"))
filter_3 <- map(data_all$data, function(x) x %>% filter(Infections == "PBS;PBS"))
filter_4 <- map(data_all$data, function(x) x %>% filter(Infections == "PR8;CA07"))
#filter_5 <- map(data_all$data, function(x) x %>% filter(Infections == "Unknown"))

names(filter_1) <- paste(names(filter_1), "CA07;CA07", sep = "_")
names(filter_2) <- paste(names(filter_2), "PBS;CA07", sep = "_")
names(filter_3) <- paste(names(filter_3), "PBS;PBS", sep = "_")
names(filter_4) <- paste(names(filter_4), "PR8;CA07", sep = "_")
#names(filter_5) <- paste(names(filter_5), "Unknown", sep = "_")

data_all$data <- flatten(list(filter_1, filter_2, filter_3, filter_4))

# Filter out the two samples in rep 2 where there is no PBS;PBS clonotypes
#data_all$data <- data_all$data[-c(15,16)]

# Sort the samples by replicate order
data_all$data <- data_all$data[order(names(data_all$data))]

# Sort the df by descending number of clones
data_all$data <- map(data_all$data, function(x) arrange(x, desc(Clones)))

# Rename the isotype to be more concise, recalculate the clonal proportion, get the full-length aa sequence
for (i in 1:length(data_all$data)){
  data_all$data[[i]]$Proportion <- data_all$data[[i]]$Clones/sum(data_all$data[[i]]$Clones)}

# Format the metadata
data_all$meta <- data_frame(Sample = names(data_all$data),
                            Replicate = str_split(names(data_all$data), "_", simplify = T)[,3],
                            Chain = str_split(names(data_all$data), "_", simplify = T)[,4],
                            Method = "sc",
                            Infections = str_split(names(data_all$data), "_", simplify = T)[,5])

data_all$meta$Infection_1 <-  str_split(data_all$meta$Infections, ";", simplify = T)[,1]
data_all$meta$Infection_2 <-  str_split(data_all$meta$Infections, ";", simplify = T)[,2]
data_all$meta$Sample_Number <- NA
#data_all$meta$Infection_2 <- str_replace_all(data_all$meta$Infection_2, "^$", "Unknown")

map(data_all$data, function(x) table(x$HA.binding))

# Save the processed clonotypes as an R object
saveRDS(data_all, "./data_all_sc.RDS")
```
